NAD+ is an essential metabolite that declines as you age. Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) is a naturally occurring compound that has been found to be orally bioavailable, and to support NAD+ levels within liver and muscle tissue.
Neurogan NMN Tablets contains powerful Nicotinamide Mononucleotide and other rich nutrients that support your NAD Levels so your body gets the boost it needs to reduce the signs of aging.
Suggested use
Take 1 to 2 serving per day. Chew carefully for 20-40 seconds and let it dissolve in your mouth before swallowing.
Other ingredients
Magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, dicalcium phosphate, silicon dioxide, powder sugar, fructose, peppermint powder, and pectin.
Warnings
Use only as directed. Consult your physician before use if you are pregnant or nursing, have serious medical condition, or use prescription medications. For adult use only. Keep out of reach of children.
